rationale: This plan provides a complete portfolio view: load_tables initializes the analysis; claim_volume by claim_status with figure=true produces the required status distribution chart; denial_rate and fraud_prevalence answer the key rate questions; financial_summary on billed, allowed, and paid amounts addresses the financial picture; monthly_trend tracks how claim volume moved over time; write_report compiles findings with synthetic data and descriptive-analysis caveats, citing artifacts throughout. All components use only catalogue options and will produce the six required artifacts.
